{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check the unique values in customer_segment
df_segment = df['customer_segment'].unique()
print(f'Unique values in customer_segment: {df_segment}')

# Check how many loyal customers there are
n_loyal = len(df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'])
print(f'Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}')

# Check how many converted orders among loyal customers
converted_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']['converted'].sum()
print(f'Number of converted orders among loyal customers: {converted_loyal}')

# Compute the fraction
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / n_loyal
print(f'Fraction converted among loyal customers: {fraction_converted}')"}
